events.title: Rome defeats Carthage at the Aegates Islands
events.description: A new Roman fleet destroyed a Carthaginian relief fleet off western Sicily. Carthage sued for peace, ending the First Punic War and ceding Sicily, Rome's first overseas province.
events.html: A new Roman fleet destroyed a Carthaginian relief fleet off western Sicily. Carthage sued for peace, ending the First Punic War and ceding Sicily, Rome's first overseas province.

events.title: Charles I dissolves Parliament and begins his Personal Rule
events.description: After clashes over taxation and religion, Charles dissolved Parliament and governed without one for eleven years. Financial need forced him to recall it in 1640, leading to civil war.
events.html: After clashes over taxation and religion, Charles dissolved Parliament and governed without one for eleven years. Financial need forced him to recall it in 1640, leading to civil war.

events.title: Upper Louisiana formally passes to the United States
events.description: In a ceremony at St Louis, the Spanish flag was lowered and the French tricolour raised, then the next day replaced by the Stars and Stripes. It completed the transfer of the Louisiana Purchase.
events.html: In a ceremony at St Louis, the Spanish flag was lowered and the French tricolour raised, then the next day replaced by the Stars and Stripes. It completed the transfer of the Louisiana Purchase.

events.title: US Senate ratifies the Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo
events.description: The Senate approved the peace with Mexico, which ceded California and much of the Southwest. The United States paid 15 million dollars and assumed its citizens' claims against Mexico.
events.html: The Senate approved the peace with Mexico, which ceded California and much of the Southwest. The United States paid 15 million dollars and assumed its citizens' claims against Mexico.

events.title: Bell makes the first telephone call
events.description: In his Boston laboratory Alexander Graham Bell spoke into his transmitter: 'Mr Watson, come here, I want to see you.' His assistant Thomas Watson heard him in the next room.
events.html: In his Boston laboratory Alexander Graham Bell spoke into his transmitter: 'Mr Watson, come here, I want to see you.' His assistant Thomas Watson heard him in the next room.

events.title: James Earl Ray pleads guilty to killing Martin Luther King Jr.
events.description: Ray was sentenced to 99 years in prison. Days later he recanted his plea and sought a trial for the rest of his life, fuelling persistent claims of a conspiracy.

events.title: Nasdaq peaks at the height of the dot-com bubble
events.description: The technology-heavy Nasdaq Composite index closed at 5,048, more than double its level a year earlier. It then fell by nearly 80 per cent by October 2002 as internet stocks collapsed.
